## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Handle draft-7 list-form `items` in `JsonSchemaTransformer`, `TestModel` and Mistral streamed output, and make `TestModel` accept boolean subschemas and cap `prefixItems` at `maxItems` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9560
* Fix `ImageGeneration` under `FallbackModel` and `dataclasses.replace`, and compare `Embedder` by identity by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9477
* Refuse a second durable execution engine on an agent before either binds by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9391
* Make `wrap_*` hooks enclose complete stage lifecycles by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7053
* Re-raise model errors from Temporal model activities with their original type in workflow code by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9580
* End the run when a `BackgroundTools` tool raises an unexpected exception, as a sequential tool does by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9434
* Drop the `SubAgents` `agent_folders` default-chan
